tripleRule: Victim-local; centre-growing and rotating compositions allowed, especially Kitsune. No inter-player flight in triple mode.
wrongAnswer: The mistaken fighter’s own local signature; no opposing attack.

fullUnitSuite.note: Full suite passed during the VFX increment; subsequent quality and orientation refinements are covered by the final focused and native runs below.

resume: Version 3 cinematic deadlines; version 2 historic deadlines and settings preserved; actual v2 triple contact verified before its one-second deadline.
artwork: 120 distinct physical RGBA cells verified for dimensions, content, hashes, transparent corners and exact identity/state mapping; originals copied without raster editing.
preload: Five health atlases fetched and decoded before play; decoded image references and blob URLs retained until disposal. Offline team matches and health transitions verified.
rasterQuality: VFX DPI starts capped at 1.5 on small screens, 2 elsewhere; high frame latency lowers raster resolution, then particle density if required; motion remains enabled. DOM text and mascot resolution unaffected.
